firstProofObligations.oracle: onAttack selects ult for slotRole=ultimate; missing ult degrades to attack (CombatScene.combatAnimations.test.ts)
acceptable-key set prevents rebuild churn; atlas-miss stable (TranPhapCombatPreviewScene.test.ts)

invariants.statement: A mapped player profile id resolves to its character slug before any texture/clip lookup (resolvePlayerEntityKey); unmapped profiles keep the legacy combatTextureKey path.
Every combat-path consumer that draws or animates the player resolves through resolvePlayerEntityKey, so a mapped profile always presents its character art - never the profile PNG - inside combat.

A cast whose declared action slot IS the actor's ultimate slot emits slotRole 'ultimate' on turn_cast_start; any other slot emits 'basic'/'special'. Ultimate playback requests 'ult'; missing 'ult' falls back to 'attack' - the cast tell is never silently lost.

When an animated variant's atlas sheet is absent, the sprite draws its registered avatar (full-body still) with the avatar's own sourceSize/extent - never atlas sizing on the wrong texture, never a bare Rectangle while the avatar exists.

CHARACTER_ART rows equal the generated manifest: sheet/atlas/avatar files on disk, exact clip frame ranges and per-clip sheet placement, avatarSize matching the real PNG. Only reskin-mapped slugs register as animated - unmapped variants never load into combat.

TranPhapCombatPreviewScene resolves player art through the same reskin/draw chain as CombatScene and accepts every texture the chain can legitimately produce (idle sheet, avatar, fallback) - a valid sprite is never rebuilt on sync.

Animation transitions never resurrect or repaint a dead entity: death clips complete into destroy/corpse state; a pending ANIMATION_COMPLETE listener cannot swap a stale atlas back over a corpse or a static swap.

lessons.escapeReason: sync guard compared a single texture key while the draw chain produces several legitimate ones
proposedProtection: mirror the full draw chain in rebuild guards - acceptable-key sets, not single keys

lessons.escapeReason: optional clips had no fallback chain - missing ult skipped the attack tell entirely
proposedProtection: explicit MISSING_CLIP_FALLBACK table; pin every degrade hop in tests

lessons.escapeReason: harness mirrored the pre-change contract; additive event field covered by types only
proposedProtection: mock the resolution function not its output; pin new event fields end-to-end

lessons.escapeReason: swap paths carried pending animation listeners, mismatched sizing metadata, and relied on Phaser incidental behavior
proposedProtection: stop+clear listeners on texture swap; sizing follows the drawn texture; make degradation explicit (zero-frame == missing)

lessons.escapeReason: registry keyspace shared across monster/character/companion domains with last-writer-wins registration
proposedProtection: pin namespace disjointness in the architecture test so collisions fail at CI not runtime

lessons.escapeReason: provenance-only fields, non-combat surfaces, and staged-not-wired assets are design decisions not defects
proposedProtection: record non-actionable observations with rationale so future reviewers do not re-litigate them

lessons.escapeReason: empty-anim hazard guarded on the main playback path but the death/preview bypass paths were written before the guard class existed
proposedProtection: any path calling sprite.play on a registered clip must check frames.length, not only exists()

lessons.escapeReason: slotRole added to the live emit path but the resume payload schema was not extended - replay dropped the field
proposedProtection: when a payload field drives selection, audit every replay/resume re-emit site

lessons.escapeReason: queued/repeat executions carry slot null by design - reviewer needed the contract stated to rule it
proposedProtection: document non-slot execution classes explicitly in the castSlotRole contract

lessons.escapeReason: test emitted the pre-reskin animation key so the completion handler ignored it - the guard under test never ran
proposedProtection: assert completion signals with the RESOLVED key (entityAnimationKeyPrefix), never the profile texture key

lessons.escapeReason: asymmetric player/enemy guard and un-pinned slug-vs-profile keyspace - cosmetic, deferred by rule
proposedProtection: when a second character set lands, add the player-branch textures.exists gate and the cross-namespace disjointness pin

lessons.escapeReason: multi-sheet clips made partial-load failure reachable; the destination hop was the last unguarded play() site
proposedProtection: every play() call - including event-callback hops - must route through the guarded entry point (playCombatAnimation), never bare play()

lessons.escapeReason: idle replay on mid-turn swap is pre-wave behavior; reviewer needed it stated to rule
proposedProtection: none - recorded as ruled-acceptable semantics

lessons.escapeReason: player draw branch grew an avatar fallback but the chain terminated without the enemy branchs last-resort Rectangle - every new branch that re-derives the draw chain must end on the same terminal elements
proposedProtection: draw-chain implementations must share the terminal fallback sequence; pin: double-miss never produces __MISSING

lessons.escapeReason: optional fields emitted as present-but-undefined pass type checks yet crash Object.values consumers; optional means absent-key, not undefined-value
proposedProtection: pin: no Object.values(collection) may yield undefined; construct optional keys conditionally

lessons.escapeReason: packer ran shape validation after side-effectful writes - ordering gave partial output and unchecked index contiguity registered frames for un-emitted PNGs
proposedProtection: all validation precedes all writes in emitters; assert frame-index contiguity when ranges are derived from indices

lessons.escapeReason: degradation chains were designed for transition clips only; loop destinations had no missing-clip path so a partial sheet failure froze the last transition frame
proposedProtection: every clip class (transition AND loop) needs a missing-clip substitute; cross-referencing fallbacks require a visited set

lessons.escapeReason: the empty-anim guard class was applied to combat + preview but not to dormant scenes (MainScene/TribulationScene) - same class, different reachability
proposedProtection: when a guard class lands, enumerate every .play() call site in the repo, not only reachable ones

lessons.escapeReason: the death sequence owns the animation channel only implicitly - nothing stopped a late event from play()ing over the death clip; flag-clear ordering then compounded it at restart
proposedProtection: every state that owns a channel (dying, spawning, swapping) needs an explicit gate on the play path; reset ordering: clear flags before replays

lessons.escapeReason: the acceptable-texture set was built when the draw chain had three tiers; adding a fourth tier (terminal fallback) without updating the comparator re-created the rebuild-every-sync defect
proposedProtection: when a draw chain grows a tier, its acceptable-set mirrors must grow in the same change

lessons.escapeReason: sizing metadata tracked a draw chain one tier shallower than the real one; the rule already stated (sizing belongs to the drawn texture) was not enforced at the deepest tier
proposedProtection: resolve metrics from the texture actually drawn (gameSprite.texture.key), not the tier the chain was supposed to stop at

lessons.escapeReason: slot identity lived only in action.slot, which is absent on the resolve turn - a multi-phase action loses its role label between commit and resolve unless identity is carried on chargedSkill
proposedProtection: role labels for multi-phase actions must be derivable from the captured payload, not only the phase-local slot object

lessons.escapeReason: the dump dir naming convention was special-cased for death instead of following the shared prefix rule
proposedProtection: dir-name parsers must accept every layout the convention permits, or fail loudly

lessons.escapeReason: two defaults for the same provenance field diverged silently
proposedProtection: a field with two failure paths gets one shared default constant

lessons.escapeReason: loop requests were applied immediately even while a one-shot transition was armed; no test simulated a mid-clip turn-end
proposedProtection: defer loop requests behind armed one-shot transitions; pin with a mid-clip standby_to_idle test

lessons.escapeReason: slotRole could not express a declared turn that is not a cast; channeling turns replayed the attack tell
proposedProtection: distinguish non-cast declared turns via a 'none' role; pin at emit and at the feedback consumer

lessons.escapeReason: partial multi-sheet loss left the sprite on the last clip frame; no restore path existed
proposedProtection: capture pre-clip base texture and restore it when the whole destination chain is unplayable

lessons.escapeReason: impulse ran before the dying guard; dormant-mode consumers bypassed the reskin resolver
proposedProtection: order dying guards before visual side-effects; route every player-key resolution through resolvePlayerEntityKey

lessons.escapeReason: the home bundle enumerated profile keys directly; dormant mode hid it

lessons.escapeReason: the swap path accumulated five defensive guards none of which had a failing oracle
